name: coin-ping-test
description: Electron app for coin ping audio analysis and resonance matching.

scripts.dev: yarn check-node && concurrently -k -s command-1 -n renderer,electron "yarn dev:renderer" "yarn dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: yarn build:electron && wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: yarn check-node && yarn build:renderer && yarn build:electron
